snippet.title: SORT MY PIGS Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5151340/Sort_My_Pigs/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=organic

Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn hearts, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, no motion sickness, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.

#indiegame #sortinggames #cozygames #organizinggame
